stability: This catalog and accompanying schema describe exactly version 1.0. Codes retain their meanings within major version 1. Consumers accepting a later minor version should tolerate its documented additive codes and fields; human messages are not stable identifiers.

codes.description: Manifest must be a JSON object.
A declared digest is not lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal.
A referenced file name is not a plain allowed filename.
Data and metadata refer to the same file.
Declared byte length is outside the supported integer range.
The declared dataset is not supported by this adapter.
A required source URL does not identify the supported endpoint.
Capture timestamp is missing, malformed, or not UTC.
Geographic level or subtype is unsupported.
Series selection is empty, duplicated, or unsupported.
Selection date is missing or malformed.
Selection dates are unordered, non-Saturdays, or after capture.
A data or metadata file is a symlink.
Observed data byte length differs from its declaration.
Data bytes differ from the declared digest.
Metadata bytes differ from the declared digest.
Metadata is not an object with the declared dataset identity.
Metadata columns do not describe the supported schema.
A JSON document is syntactically invalid.
A document cannot be decoded as UTF-8.
An input file cannot be read or inspected.
CSV header differs from the supported twelve-column schema.
CSV row width differs from its header.
CSV syntax is rejected by the strict parser.
A parsed release date is after the capture date.
An observation week is not a valid source date.
A row is outside the declared geography, series, or date window.
A validation failure without a more specific typed code occurred.
No row exists for an expected series-week slot.
Multiple rows occupy one series-week slot; all are quarantined.
Release date is malformed or precedes its observation week.
A required value is marked suppressed by the source.
A required value is unavailable in the source.
Counts or percentage violate finite/range/count rules.
Displayed percentage differs from the count ratio beyond rounding tolerance.
Zero tests were reported; positivity is undefined.
